{{Infobox concept
| name   = University

A '''university''' is an institution of higher education and research that has
the authority to award [[Academic degree|academic degrees]] across a range of
subjects. It typically brings together a college of arts and sciences with
graduate and professional schools, and sits within the broader category of
[[Higher education|higher-education institutions]].<ref name="eb" /><ref name="nwe" />

Universities grant degrees at successive levels — commonly the bachelor's,
master's and doctorate — and combine teaching with the advancement of knowledge
through research.<ref name="nwe" /><ref name="unesco-hei" />

== Definition ==

Authoritative reference works converge on a compact definition: a university is
a degree-granting institution of higher learning, usually comprising a liberal
arts and sciences core together with graduate and professional faculties.<ref name="eb" />
Encyclopaedic treatments add that it conducts research and confers degrees at
every level — undergraduate through doctoral — across many fields.<ref name="nwe" />

In the wider educational system, universities are one kind of
'''higher-education institution''': establishments that provide advanced
learning beyond secondary school and award degrees and certifications, a set
that also includes colleges and specialised schools.<ref name="unesco-hei" />

== Etymology ==

The word derives from the Latin ''universitas'', denoting a whole or a corporate
body — originally a guild-like association of masters and scholars rather than a
building or a single managed institution.<ref name="hoi" /> The enduring phrase
''alma mater'' ("nourishing mother") is one of the oldest symbols of the
university, associated with the institution founded at Bologna in 1088.<ref name="wp-univ" />

== Mission ==

Higher education — the stage of learning that universities principally serve —
is widely described as a cultural and scientific asset that supports personal
development and drives economic, technological and social change, and that
advances the exchange of knowledge, research and innovation.<ref name="unesco-know" />
